description: Source code for ARM architecture GDB stub implementation in Zephyr RTOS, handling breakpoints, register access, and debugging features.

methods.name: is_bkpt
methods.description: Checks if the exception was caused by a BKPT instruction based on instruction encoding and status register.

methods.name: z_gdb_entry
methods.description: Handles GDB entry, saves registers, runs main loop, restores registers, and adjusts PC if breakpoint was hit.

methods.name: arch_gdb_init
methods.description: Initializes GDB stub, enables monitor mode, and triggers a breakpoint.

methods.name: arch_gdb_continue
methods.description: Resumes execution after a breakpoint, no operation needed.

methods.name: arch_gdb_step
methods.description: Sets a hardware breakpoint at current PC for single stepping.

methods.name: arch_gdb_reg_readall
methods.description: Reads all registers and formats them into a GDB packet.

methods.name: arch_gdb_reg_writeall
methods.description: Writes multiple registers from a GDB packet.
